No LLM-as-judge evaluation used in this paper - only automatic metrics and no LLM evaluation of generated outputs

overall_notes: The paper presents a comprehensive framework for evaluating gender fairness in LLMs using automatic metrics. The extraction was generally accurate, but needed minor normalization and removal of implementation details that weren't actual evaluation metrics. The paper focuses on text generation tasks with gender pronoun variations across multiple dimensions.
